faqs.question: How quickly does BTEL respond to inquiries?
faqs.answer: Our engineering team reviews every inquiry and responds within 24 business hours. For urgent project requirements, call our direct lines — +88 01990-515151 or +88 01755-515151.

faqs.question: Does BTEL handle turnkey projects or just supply?
faqs.answer: BTEL is a full EPC company — we handle design, supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and after-sales support. We also do supply-only for transmission line hardware and NALCO water treatment chemicals.

faqs.question: What is the minimum project size BTEL takes on?
faqs.answer: BTEL works with projects of all sizes — from a single transformer to a BDT 185 Cr MEP contract. For chemical supply, there's no minimum order. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

faqs.question: Is BTEL ISO certified?
faqs.answer: Yes. B-Trac Engineering Ltd. is an ISO 9001:2015 certified organization — covering all aspects of design, procurement, project management, installation, and after-sales service.

faqs.question: Does BTEL provide after-sales service for installed equipment?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. BTEL offers Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), on-call service, emergency response, and preventive maintenance for all installed systems — nationwide, 24/7.

faqs.question: Can BTEL supply NALCO chemicals without an engineering contract?
faqs.answer: Yes. NALCO water treatment chemicals — boiler chemicals, RO chemicals, cooling tower chemicals, and engine coolants — can be ordered as standalone supply. Contact our water treatment team for pricing and availability.
